items.title: Beyond the Diagnosis: An Integrated Perspective on Strategic Dosing in Neurologic Motor Rehabilitation. A Scoping Review and Collaborative Viewpoint.
items.summary: This scoping review and collaborative viewpoint propose an integrated, mechanism-based framework for strategic dosing in neurologic motor rehabilitation, suggesting higher intensity for non-progressive conditions and conservative strategies for progressive conditions, to address suboptimal long-term outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这份综述和专家观点提出，神经运动康复应采取基于机制的“策略性剂量”框架，而非传统的诊断驱动模式。对于非进展性疾病，你可能需要提高干预强度；而对于进展性疾病，则应采取更保守的策略，以期改善长期疗效。
items.titleZh: 超越诊断：神经运动康复中策略性剂量的综合视角。一项范围综述与合作观点
items.summaryZh: 这项范围综述和合作观点提出了神经运动康复中策略性剂量的综合性、基于机制的框架，建议对非进展性疾病采用高强度方法，对进展性疾病采用更保守、节约能量的策略，以应对长期疗效不佳的问题。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review and expert viewpoint advocate for a mechanism-based 'strategic dosing' framework in neurologic motor rehabilitation, moving beyond traditional diagnosis-driven approaches. For non-progressive conditions, you might need to increase intervention intensity; for progressive conditions, a more conservative strategy should be adopted to improve long-term outcomes.
items.limitation: 文献缺乏标准化剂量参数的共识，且综述未能提供具体剂量方案，主要集中于概念框架。
items.limitationEn: The literature lacks consensus on standardized dosing parameters, and the review does not provide specific dosing protocols, focusing primarily on conceptual frameworks.

items.title: A systematic review of early neuroimaging and neurophysiological biomarkers for post-stroke mobility prognostication.
items.summary: This systematic review examined the prognostic capacity of early neuroimaging and neurophysiological biomarkers for mobility outcomes up to 24 months post-stroke, to help guide rehabilitation planning.
items.curatedReason: 这份系统综述确认了早期神经影像学和神经生理学生物标志物在中风后24个月内对运动预后的预测价值。这意味着我们应将这些早期指标纳入评估，以更精准地识别高风险患者并优化其康复路径。
items.titleZh: 中风后运动预后早期神经影像和神经生理学生物标志物的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述旨在评估中风后14天内测量的早期神经影像学和神经生理学生物标志物，对24个月内运动结局的预测能力，以指导康复计划和目标设定。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review confirms the prognostic value of early neuroimaging and neurophysiological biomarkers for mobility outcomes up to 24 months post-stroke. We should integrate these early indicators into our assessments to more accurately identify high-risk patients and optimize their rehabilitation pathways.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的方法学存在偏倚风险，且生物标志物分析方法多样，限制了结果的综合性。
items.limitationEn: The included studies had a risk of methodological bias, and the diverse biomarker analysis approaches limited the generalizability of results.

items.title: Survey on stroke rehabilitation in Europe (SUSTAIN-EU) to evaluate European stroke rehabilitation services.
items.summary: The SUSTAIN-EU survey assessed the organization and delivery of post-stroke rehabilitation services across 30 European countries, revealing commonalities and disparities in service provision with an 81% response rate.
items.curatedReason: 这项覆盖30个欧洲国家的调查揭示了中风康复服务在组织和提供上的显著差异与共性。尽管不能直接指导临床操作，但你可以此为镜，审视和思考你所在地区康复服务的优化空间，尤其是在服务公平性和效率方面。
items.titleZh: 欧洲中风康复调查（SUSTAIN-EU）评估欧洲中风康复服务
items.summaryZh: SUSTAIN-EU 调查评估了30个欧洲国家中风后康复服务的组织和提供情况，以81%的回复率揭示了服务提供上的共通之处和差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This survey across 30 European countries highlights significant commonalities and disparities in the organization and delivery of stroke rehabilitation services. While not directly guiding clinical practice, you can use this as a benchmark to assess and consider optimization opportunities for rehabilitation services in your region, particularly regarding equity and efficiency.
items.limitation: 这是一项描述性横断面调查研究，无法评估干预措施的因果关系或服务质量。
items.limitationEn: This is a descriptive cross-sectional survey study and cannot assess causal relationships of interventions or service quality.

items.title: Characteristics of Classified Gait Pattern Subgroups and Definitions of Abnormal Gait Patterns Following Stroke: A Scoping Review.
items.summary: This scoping review explored existing characteristics of classified gait pattern subgroups and definitions of abnormal gait patterns following stroke, finding a lack of standardized definitions despite the importance of individualized gait training.
items.curatedReason: 中风后步态模式的分类和异常步态的定义至今仍缺乏标准化，这意味着我们目前在进行个体化步态训练时，所依赖的分类框架可能存在局限。在临床实践中，应警惕现有分类的普适性问题，这提示我们需要更精细的评估工具。
items.titleZh: 中风后分类步态模式亚组特征及异常步态模式定义：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 这项范围综述探讨了中风后步态模式亚组的分类特征和异常步态模式的定义，发现尽管个体化步态训练日益重要，但标准化定义仍然缺乏。
items.curatedReasonEn: Standardized definitions for post-stroke gait patterns and abnormal gait are still missing, indicating limitations in current classification frameworks for individualized gait training. In practice, be aware of the generalizability issues with existing classifications; this highlights the need for more refined assessment tools.
items.limitation: 这是一项范围综述，并未对文献进行质量评估，且研究缺乏标准化定义和分类。
items.limitationEn: This is a scoping review that did not assess literature quality, and studies lacked standardized definitions and classifications.

items.title: Effectiveness of a Personalized Robot-Assisted Trunk and Lower Limb Rehabilitation in Patients with Chronic Stroke: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=40) found that adding personalized robot-assisted trunk and lower limb training to conventional rehabilitation significantly improved Functional Ambulatory Category (FAC) scores in patients with chronic stroke over 3 months.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 证实，在常规康复基础上增加个性化机器人辅助躯干和下肢训练，能显著改善慢性卒中患者的步行功能。这意味着你可以考虑将这类机器人辅助疗法整合到慢性卒中患者的康复方案中，尤其是对于改善独立步行能力。
items.titleZh: 个性化机器人辅助躯干和下肢康复对慢性卒中患者的疗效：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=40）发现，在常规康复基础上增加个性化机器人辅助躯干和下肢训练，可在 3 个月内显著改善慢性卒中患者的功能性步行分类 (FAC) 评分。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT confirms that adding personalized robot-assisted trunk and lower limb training to conventional rehabilitation significantly improves walking function in chronic stroke patients. This implies you can consider integrating such robot-assisted therapy into chronic stroke rehabilitation protocols, especially for enhancing independent ambulation.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（n=40），且随访期仅为 3 个月，长期效果和更大样本的普适性尚需进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (n=40) and a follow-up period of only 3 months; long-term effects and generalizability to larger populations require further validation.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Responsiveness, Smallest Detectable Change, and Minimal Important Change of the Turkish Pelvic Floor Distress Inventory-20 Following Pelvic Floor Muscle Training.
items.summary: A multicenter retrospective study of 200 women with pelvic floor dysfunction found the Turkish Pelvic Floor Distress Inventory-20 (PFDI-20) to be responsive to pelvic floor muscle training, establishing its smallest detectable change (SDC) and minimal important change (MIC).
items.curatedReason: 本研究确立了土耳其语版 PFDI-20 量表在盆底肌肉训练后，响应性良好且最小可检测变化 (SDC) 和最小重要变化 (MIC) 的具体值。这有助于你更精准地评估土耳其裔盆底功能障碍患者的治疗效果，判断临床有意义的改善。
items.titleZh: 土耳其语版盆底功能障碍问卷-20 (PFDI-20) 在盆底肌肉训练后的响应性、最小可检测变化和最小重要变化
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 200 名盆底功能障碍女性的多中心回顾性研究显示，土耳其语版 PFDI-20 量表在盆底肌肉训练后响应性良好，并确立了其最小可检测变化 (SDC) 和最小重要变化 (MIC)。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study establishes the responsiveness, SDC, and MIC for the Turkish PFDI-20 after pelvic floor muscle training. This helps you more precisely evaluate treatment efficacy and identify clinically meaningful improvements in Turkish-speaking patients with pelvic floor dysfunction.
items.limitation: 本回顾性研究是在土耳其人群中进行的，其 SDC 和 MIC 值可能不完全适用于其他文化或语言背景的患者。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective study was conducted in a Turkish population, and its SDC and MIC values may not be fully applicable to patients from other cultural or linguistic backgrounds.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Relief increases select shoulder muscle activity, following subacromial injection in subacromial pain syndrome.
items.summary: This study investigated the effects of immediate and long-term pain reduction on shoulder muscle activation in 21 individuals with subacromial pain syndrome, finding that a subacromial injection led to increased select shoulder muscle activity.
items.curatedReason: 局部麻醉性注射能够即时改善肩峰下疼痛综合征患者的肩部肌肉激活，即使在物理治疗后，这种改善也能维持。评估患者对短期镇痛的反应，可能帮你筛选出对后续康复训练反应更好的患者。
items.titleZh: 肩峰下注射减轻疼痛后，肩峰下疼痛综合征患者选择性肩部肌肉活动增加
items.summaryZh: 这项研究调查了 21 名肩峰下疼痛综合征患者在疼痛减轻后肩部肌肉激活的变化，发现肩峰下注射可即时增加部分肩部肌肉的活动。
items.curatedReasonEn: Local anesthetic injections might immediately improve shoulder muscle activation in patients with subacromial pain syndrome, with benefits potentially sustained post-physical therapy. Consider using a patient’s response to short-term analgesia as a screening tool; it could help predict those who will respond better to subsequent rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小，且无法完全排除肌电信号变异性对结果的影响。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size, and could not completely exclude the impact of EMG signal variability on the results.
items.journal: Journal of electromyography and kinesiology : official journal of the International Society of Electrophysiological Kinesiology

items.title: Ethics and Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Stroke Rehabilitation.
items.summary: This commentary explores the ethical considerations surrounding the increasing integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into stroke rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 随着人工智能在卒中康复中的应用日益增多，理解其伦理考量变得至关重要。这篇述评能帮你预判潜在的公平性、隐私和责任问题，以便在临床实践中更负责任地部署 AI 技术。
items.titleZh: 卒中康复中的伦理与人工智能
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评探讨了人工智能在卒中康复中日益增长的应用所涉及的伦理考量。
items.curatedReasonEn: As AI increasingly integrates into stroke rehabilitation, understanding its ethical considerations is crucial. This commentary helps you anticipate potential issues of fairness, privacy, and accountability for more responsible AI deployment in clinical practice.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Mental health in elite athletes: International Olympic Committee consensus statement (2026)
items.summary: The updated International Olympic Committee consensus statement (2026) emphasizes that mental health symptoms and disorders are common in elite athletes, may be sport-related, and impact performance, recommending routine screening and monitoring.
items.curatedReason: 这份 IOC 共识声明强调精英运动员心理健康问题普遍且可能与运动相关，并推荐使用验证工具进行常规筛查和监测。它确认了心理健康在运动康复中的重要性，你在日常实践中应更关注运动员的心理状态并考虑恰当的转诊。
items.titleZh: 精英运动员心理健康：国际奥委会共识声明（2026）
items.summaryZh: 更新后的国际奥委会共识声明（2026）强调，精英运动员的心理健康症状和障碍普遍存在，可能与运动相关并影响表现，建议进行常规筛查和监测。
items.curatedReasonEn: This IOC consensus statement highlights the prevalence of mental health issues in elite athletes, their potential sport-related etiologies, and recommends routine screening and monitoring. It affirms the importance of mental health in sports rehabilitation, prompting you to pay closer attention to athletes' psychological states and consider appropriate referrals.

items.title: Understanding the family planning experiences and information needs of people living with multiple sclerosis: an Australian cohort study.
items.summary: An Australian cross-sectional study of 270 people with multiple sclerosis (MS) found that 44.0% reported MS impacted their reproductive planning decisions, and 14.7% decided against having children due to MS.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了多发性硬化症（MS）对澳大利亚患者生育计划的显著影响，其中近一半患者表示MS影响了生育决定。这提示你在与MS患者讨论康复计划时，需要主动纳入生育考量。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚队列研究：理解多发性硬化症患者的生育计划经历和信息需求
items.summaryZh: 一项对270名澳大利亚多发性硬化症患者进行的横断面研究发现，44.0%的受访者表示MS影响了他们的生育规划决定，14.7%的受访者因MS决定不生育。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study highlights the significant impact of MS on family planning decisions among Australian patients, with nearly half reporting an influence on reproductive choices. When discussing rehabilitation plans with MS patients, proactively incorporate family planning considerations.
items.limitation: 研究为横断面设计，无法建立因果关系，且可能存在回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: The study's cross-sectional design prevents establishing causality and may be subject to recall bias.

items.title: Physical and mental health-related quality of life outcomes of non-pharmacological interventions in early multiple sclerosis: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis found non-pharmacological interventions to improve physical and mental health-related quality of life in adults with early-stage multiple sclerosis and minimal disability.
items.curatedReason: 这份系统综述和荟萃分析强调了早期多发性硬化症非药物干预对改善身体和精神健康相关生活质量的重要性。将其纳入你的临床实践考量，尤其是在疾病早期阶段。
items.titleZh: 早期多发性硬化症非药物干预对身心健康相关生活质量结局的影响：一项系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述与荟萃分析发现，非药物干预能改善早期多发性硬化症且残疾程度轻微的成年患者的身心健康相关生活质量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review and meta-analysis highlights the importance of non-pharmacological interventions in improving physical and mental health-related quality of life in early multiple sclerosis. Integrate these findings into your clinical practice, especially for patients in early disease stages.
items.limitation: 研究只纳入了早期多发性硬化症且残疾程度轻微的患者，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study only included patients with early multiple sclerosis and minimal disability, limiting the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Exercise Interventions for Older Adults with Alzheimer's Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis investigated the effectiveness and optimal dosage of physical exercise on cognitive function in older adults with Alzheimer's disease.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述肯定了运动干预对阿尔茨海默病老年患者认知功能的益处。在设计康复方案时，应将运动作为核心要素，并关注最佳剂量以最大化疗效。
items.titleZh: 运动干预对阿尔茨海默病老年患者的影响：一项系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述与荟萃分析探讨了运动干预对阿尔茨海默病老年患者认知功能的有效性及其最佳剂量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review confirms the benefits of exercise interventions for cognitive function in older adults with Alzheimer's disease. Incorporate exercise as a core component in rehabilitation programs, and consider optimal dosages to maximize effectiveness.
items.limitation: 综述未明确指出不同运动类型或强度的具体效果差异，也未给出明确的“最佳剂量”数据。
items.limitationEn: The review did not explicitly detail the differential effects of various exercise types or intensities, nor did it provide specific “optimal dosage” data.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Clinically interpretable prediction models of stroke functional outcomes: A national cohort study of adults in inpatient rehabilitation facilities in the US.
items.summary: A national retrospective cohort study (n=43,745) of US stroke patients in inpatient rehabilitation facilities developed clinically interpretable machine learning models to predict self-care and mobility function at discharge using IRF-PAI variables.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究基于美国大规模真实世界数据，构建了可靠的卒中康复出院功能预测模型。它能帮你预估患者自理和活动功能，辅助制定更切合实际的康复目标和出院计划。
items.titleZh: 美国住院康复机构卒中患者功能结局的临床可解释预测模型：一项全国队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对美国住院康复机构43,745名卒中患者进行的全国回顾性队列研究，利用IRF-PAI变量构建了临床可解释的机器学习模型，以预测出院时的自理和活动功能。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study, based on large-scale US real-world data, developed reliable prediction models for stroke rehabilitation functional outcomes at discharge. It can help you estimate patient self-care and mobility functions, aiding in setting more realistic rehabilitation goals and discharge plans.
items.limitation: 作为回顾性队列研究，尽管样本量大，但可能存在未测量混杂因素的风险，且模型基于IRF-PAI变量，可能无法捕捉所有临床复杂性。
items.limitationEn: As a retrospective cohort study, despite its large sample size, there's a risk of unmeasured confounders, and the model, based on IRF-PAI variables, may not capture all clinical complexities.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Effect of kinesiology taping on limb oedema in patients with severe hyper-dependency using shear-wave elastography: a randomized clinical trial.
items.summary: A randomized clinical trial (n=50) demonstrated that kinesiology taping at 25% tension significantly reduced the dermal elastic coefficient and limb circumference in patients with severe hyper-dependency limb oedema compared to 0% tension taping by day 9.
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT研究表明，25%张力的肌内效贴能显著减少严重肢体水肿患者的真皮弹性系数，提示其在改善水肿方面有一定潜力。考虑将其作为辅助手段，尤其是当你希望减少组织硬度时。
items.titleZh: 肌内效贴在严重高依赖性肢体水肿患者中对肢体水肿的影响：一项随机临床试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机临床试验（n=50）表明，与0%张力贴扎相比，25%张力的肌内效贴能显著降低严重高依赖性肢体水肿患者的真皮弹性系数和肢体周长，效应在第9天显著。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that kinesiology taping at 25% tension significantly reduces dermal elastic coefficient in patients with severe limb edema, indicating its potential in edema reduction. Consider it as an adjunct, especially when aiming to reduce tissue stiffness.
items.limitation: 研究关注的是弹力系数和肢体周长，但并未评估患者功能或疼痛等更全面的临床结局，且随访时间较短。
items.limitationEn: The study focused on elastic coefficient and limb circumference but did not assess broader clinical outcomes such like patient function or pain, and the follow-up period was relatively short.

items.title: Reliability and construct validity of three movement-evoked pain methods in individuals with knee osteoarthritis.
items.summary: This study evaluated the reliability and construct validity of three movement-evoked pain calculation methods using performance-based tests in 111 individuals with knee osteoarthritis, finding varying levels of reliability and validity.
items.curatedReason: 对于膝骨关节炎（KOA）患者，运动诱发疼痛的测量方法并非都一样可靠。你需要留意，本研究评估的三种计算方法，其信度和效度各有不同，这提示我们在选择评估工具时，务必结合具体临床情境，避免盲目采纳。
items.titleZh: 膝骨关节炎患者三种运动诱发疼痛测量方法的信度与结构效度
items.summaryZh: 这项研究评估了111名膝骨关节炎患者，在基于表现的测试中，三种运动诱发疼痛计算方法的信度和结构效度，发现其可靠性和有效性存在差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Not all methods for measuring movement-evoked pain in KOA are equally reliable. This study, evaluating three calculation methods, shows varying levels of reliability and validity, suggesting you must be judicious in selecting assessment tools based on your specific clinical context.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小，且为单一中心观察性研究的二次分析，可能限制了结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study's relatively small sample size and secondary analysis from a single-center observational study may limit the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Feasibility and acceptability of the breakfast group intervention BISTRo for stroke survivors in acute rehabilitation.
items.summary: A mixed-methods feasibility study evaluated the BISTRo breakfast group intervention for 16 stroke survivors in UK acute rehabilitation, finding it feasible and acceptable to both patients and multidisciplinary staff.
items.curatedReason: 这项可行性研究提示，多学科协作的早餐小组干预对卒中急性期患者是可行的且接受度良好。如果你在急性康复科工作，可以考虑将此类结构化社交用餐模式纳入日常。
items.titleZh: 卒中急性期康复患者早餐小组干预BISTRo的可行性和可接受性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项混合方法可行性研究评估了英国急性期卒中康复患者的BISTRo早餐小组干预，发现其对患者和多学科工作人员来说都具有可行性和可接受性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This feasibility study suggests that a multidisciplinary breakfast group intervention is feasible and well-accepted for acute stroke survivors. If you work in acute rehabilitation, consider integrating such structured social dining models.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本（16名卒中幸存者，53名工作人员）的混合方法可行性研究，其结果主要验证干预的可行性和接受度，而非临床疗效。
items.limitationEn: This is a small-sample (16 stroke survivors, 53 staff) mixed-methods feasibility study, primarily validating the intervention's feasibility and acceptability rather than clinical efficacy.

items.title: Methodological characteristics of perturbation-based balance training in healthy older adults: A scoping review.
items.summary: This scoping review mapped the methodological features of mechanically induced perturbation-based balance training interventions in healthy older adults, analyzing studies from inception through April 2025 across multiple databases.
items.curatedReason: 这份范围综述清晰展现了健康老年人扰动式平衡训练的研究现状。你会发现现有干预措施在方法学上仍有许多空白和不一致之处，因此在将这类训练应用于临床前，需警惕其异质性，并期待未来有更标准化、证据更强的研究出现。
items.titleZh: 健康老年人扰动式平衡训练的方法学特征：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 这项范围综述系统梳理了截至2025年4月，机械诱导扰动式平衡训练干预在健康老年人中的方法学特征。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review maps the current landscape of perturbation-based balance training in healthy older adults. You'll note significant methodological gaps and inconsistencies in existing interventions, so be cautious about heterogeneity before clinical application, and look for more standardized, evidence-backed research in the future.
items.limitation: 范围综述的性质决定了它着重于映射研究特征而非评估证据质量或进行元分析，因此无法提供具体的临床行动建议。
items.limitationEn: The nature of a scoping review focuses on mapping study characteristics rather than assessing evidence quality or performing meta-analysis, thus it cannot provide specific clinical action recommendations.

items.title: Incidence and risk factors for rotator cuff retear after arthroscopic rotator cuff repair in middle-aged and older patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: This systematic review and meta-analysis investigated the incidence and risk factors for rotator cuff retear after arthroscopic repair in middle-aged and older patients.
items.curatedReason: 肩袖修复术后翻修是临床难题。这份系统综述和荟萃分析提供了中年及老年患者术后翻修率的汇总数据及风险因素，为你在术后康复评估和风险沟通时提供了重要的循证依据。
items.titleZh: 中年及老年患者关节镜下肩袖修复术后肩袖再撕裂的发生率及风险因素：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述和荟萃分析考察了中年及老年患者关节镜下肩袖修复术后肩袖再撕裂的发生率及风险因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: Rotator cuff retear after repair is a clinical challenge. This systematic review and meta-analysis provides pooled data on retear rates and risk factors in middle-aged and older patients, offering crucial evidence for your post-operative rehabilitation assessment and risk communication.
items.limitation: 研究未详细说明纳入的各项研究中患者的康复方案差异，这可能影响翻修率的解读。
items.limitationEn: The study did not detail the rehabilitation protocol variations across included studies, which might influence the interpretation of retear rates.

items.title: Effects of functional versus conventional Physiotherapy-Based pain management on symptoms, psychological outcomes, and quality of life in women with Bladder Pain Syndrome: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=28) found that functional physiotherapy (pain science education, cognition-targeted exercises) improved symptoms, psychological outcomes, and quality of life in women with Bladder Pain Syndrome compared to conventional TENS.
items.curatedReason: 这项小样本 RCT 提示，对于膀胱疼痛综合征患者，结合疼痛教育和认知靶向运动的功能性物理治疗，可能在症状、心理和生活质量方面优于传统电刺激方案。评估不同物理治疗方案时，考虑其更全面的干预潜力。
items.titleZh: 功能性与传统物理治疗对膀胱疼痛综合征女性患者症状、心理结局及生活质量的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对28名膀胱疼痛综合征女性患者的随机对照试验发现，功能性物理治疗（疼痛科学教育、认知靶向运动）在症状、心理结局和生活质量方面优于传统经皮电刺激（TENS）方案。
items.curatedReasonEn: This small RCT suggests that functional physiotherapy, incorporating pain education and cognitive-targeted exercises, may offer broader benefits in symptoms, psychological outcomes, and quality of life for bladder pain syndrome patients compared to conventional TENS. Consider the comprehensive intervention potential when evaluating different PT approaches.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（n=28），且评估时间点未明确，可能限制结果的普适性。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (n=28) and unclear assessment time points, which may limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Effects of hyperbaric oxygen therapy on human musculoskeletal pathologies in clinical studies: a systematic review
items.summary: A systematic review explored the effects of hyperbaric oxygen therapy (HBOT) on human musculoskeletal pathologies in clinical studies, noting its increasing use in regenerative medicine.
items.curatedReason: 高压氧疗法（HBOT）在肌骨疾病中的应用日益增多，但目前证据多为小规模研究或个案报告，其作为辅助治疗的疗效和适应症仍不明确。在推荐给患者前，我们还需要更严谨的RCT来明确其真实效果和安全性。
items.titleZh: 高压氧疗法在人类肌肉骨骼病理临床研究中的效果：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述探讨了高压氧疗法（HBOT）在人类肌肉骨骼病理临床研究中的效果，指出其在再生医学中的应用日益增多。
items.curatedReasonEn: While hyperbaric oxygen therapy (HBOT) is increasingly used for musculoskeletal conditions, current evidence largely stems from small studies or case reports. Its efficacy and indications as an adjunctive treatment remain unclear; robust RCTs are needed to confirm its true effects and safety before widespread recommendation.
items.limitation: 综述未提供具体效应量或疗效量化数据，使得临床应用价值判断受限。
items.limitationEn: The review does not provide specific effect sizes or quantitative efficacy data, limiting the assessment of its clinical utility.

items.title: Association between the Chinese version of the Mediterranean-DASH intervention for Neurodegenerative Delay diet and BADL/IADL disability among older adults in China: a nationwide survey
items.summary: A nationwide survey in China explored the association between adherence to the Chinese version of the Mediterranean-DASH Intervention for Neurodegenerative Delay (MIND) diet and BADL/IADL disability among older adults.
items.curatedReason: MIND 饮食法与老年人神经退行性疾病风险相关。这项全国性调查揭示了中国老年人采用 MIND 饮食与日常生活活动能力（BADL/IADL）残疾之间的关联，为你理解营养干预在老年康复中的作用提供了中国本土证据。
items.titleZh: 中国老年人地中海-DASH神经退行性延迟饮食中国版与BADL/IADL残疾的关联：一项全国性调查
items.summaryZh: 中国一项全国性调查探讨了中国版地中海-DASH神经退行性延迟饮食（MIND饮食）与老年人基本和工具性日常生活活动能力（BADL/IADL）残疾之间的关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: The MIND diet is linked to neurodegenerative disease risk in older adults. This nationwide survey reveals the association between the Chinese version of the MIND diet and BADL/IADL disability in older Chinese adults, providing local evidence for understanding nutritional interventions in geriatric rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面调查，无法确立MIND饮食与BADL/IADL残疾之间的因果关系。
items.limitationEn: As a cross-sectional survey, this study cannot establish a causal relationship between the MIND diet and BADL/IADL disability.

items.title: Association of the GAP score and roussouly-based algorithm with long-term patient-reported outcomes following adult spinal deformity surgery: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: This systematic review and meta-analysis investigated the association of the GAP score and Roussouly-based algorithm with long-term patient-reported outcomes following adult spinal deformity surgery.
items.curatedReason: 对于成人脊柱畸形术后患者，GAP评分和Roussouly分型算法的预后价值至关重要。这份系统综述和荟萃分析评估了它们与长期患者报告结局的关联，为你的康复预后判断和多学科沟通提供了新的证据。
items.titleZh: GAP评分和基于Roussouly的算法与成人脊柱畸形手术后长期患者报告结局的关联：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述和荟萃分析探讨了GAP评分和基于Roussouly的算法与成人脊柱畸形手术后长期患者报告结局之间的关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: For adult spinal deformity patients post-surgery, the prognostic value of GAP score and Roussouly-based algorithms is crucial. This systematic review and meta-analysis assesses their association with long-term patient-reported outcomes, providing new evidence for your rehabilitation prognosis and multidisciplinary communication.
items.limitation: 综述可能存在纳入研究异质性高的问题，需要对结果的普适性保持谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The review might have high heterogeneity among included studies, requiring caution regarding the generalizability of the results.

items.title: Injury epidemiology in HYROX athletes: an international cross-sectional survey
items.summary: An international cross-sectional survey investigated the injury epidemiology among HYROX athletes.
items.curatedReason: HYROX 是一项新兴的混合健身运动，了解其运动员的损伤流行病学，有助于你更好地为这类群体设计预防和康复方案，识别常见的运动风险。
items.titleZh: HYROX 运动员的损伤流行病学：一项国际横断面调查
items.summaryZh: 一项国际横断面调查研究了 HYROX 运动员的损伤流行病学。
items.curatedReasonEn: HYROX is an emerging hybrid fitness sport. Understanding its athletes' injury epidemiology helps you better design prevention and rehabilitation programs and identify common athletic risks for this population.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面调查，仅能提供损伤的流行病学描述，无法确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: As a cross-sectional survey, this study only provides epidemiological descriptions of injuries and cannot establish causality.

items.title: Characterisation of elite swimmers’ core temperature responses in European swimming competition and a pilot passive-heating intervention strategy
items.summary: This study characterized elite swimmers' core temperature responses during European competitions and piloted a passive-heating intervention strategy.
items.curatedReason: 精英游泳运动员的核心体温调控对比赛表现至关重要。这项研究揭示了比赛中体温反应的特征，并探索了被动加温干预策略，为优化运动员热身和恢复提供了新思路。
items.titleZh: 欧洲游泳比赛中精英游泳运动员核心体温反应特征及一项试点被动加温干预策略
items.summaryZh: 这项研究描绘了欧洲游泳比赛中精英游泳运动员核心体温反应的特征，并初步探索了一项被动加温干预策略。
items.curatedReasonEn: Core temperature regulation is crucial for elite swimmers' performance. This study characterizes thermoregulatory responses during competition and explores passive-heating interventions, offering new insights for optimizing athlete warm-up and recovery.
items.limitation: 本研究的被动加温干预仅为试点性质，样本量和研究设计可能不足以得出确切的干预效果结论。
items.limitationEn: The passive-heating intervention in this study is a pilot, and the sample size and design may be insufficient to draw definitive conclusions on its effectiveness.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Positional Therapy May Ease COPD Breathlessness, suggests research
items.summary: New research suggests that positional therapy may help alleviate breathlessness in patients with Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD).
items.curatedReason: 这项新闻提示，体位疗法可能有助于缓解 COPD 患者的呼吸困难。作为辅助手段，你可以了解其潜在机制和应用方式，但在纳入常规方案前仍需更多循证研究支持。
items.titleZh: 研究提示体位疗法或可缓解COPD呼吸困难
items.summaryZh: 新的研究提示，体位疗法可能有助于缓解慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）患者的呼吸困难。
items.curatedReasonEn: This news suggests that positional therapy may ease breathlessness in COPD patients. As an adjunctive method, you can explore its potential mechanisms and applications, but more evidence-based research is needed before incorporating it into routine protocols.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - Call for applications: National committees of the Chinese Medicine Board of Australia
items.summary: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) has issued a call for applications for national committees of the Chinese Medicine Board of Australia.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管局（AHPRA）正在为中医委员会招募国家委员会成员。虽然是中医领域，但了解此类机构的运作和人员构成，有助于你更好地理解澳大利亚的医疗监管框架，这对于 PT 在澳执业有间接参考价值。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管局：澳大利亚中医药管理局全国委员会成员申请
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管局（AHPRA）已发布通知，为澳大利亚中医药管理局的全国委员会招募成员。
items.curatedReasonEn: AHPRA is recruiting National Committee members for the Chinese Medicine Board. While in Chinese medicine, understanding how such bodies operate and are constituted helps you grasp Australia's healthcare regulatory framework, offering indirect relevance to PT practice in Australia.

items.title: β-Blocker Interruption Causes Heart Rate Rebound and Worse CV Outcomes in Post-MI Patients: New Pre-Specified Analysis of ABYSS Trial
items.summary: A pre-specified analysis of the ABYSS trial found that beta-blocker interruption causes heart rate rebound and worse cardiovascular outcomes in post-MI patients, particularly those with elevated baseline heart rates.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究关注的是药物干预（β受体阻滞剂）对心梗后患者心血管结局的影响。它与物理治疗的临床实践无直接关联，因此不属于康复医学新闻的范畴。
items.titleZh: ABYSS试验新预设分析：β受体阻滞剂中断导致心梗后患者心率反弹和心血管结局恶化
items.summaryZh: ABYSS试验的一项预设分析报告称，β受体阻滞剂中断会导致心梗后患者心率反弹，并导致更差的心血管结局，尤其是在基线心率较高的患者中。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study focuses on the impact of pharmacological intervention (β-blockers) on cardiovascular outcomes in post-MI patients. It has no direct relevance to physical therapy clinical practice and thus falls outside the scope of rehabilitation medicine news.

items.title: 骨折術後照顧與復健指南：多久能恢復？怎麼好得快？
items.summary: This article provides a general guide on post-fracture care and rehabilitation, covering healing stages, influencing factors, and general post-operative care for patients.
items.curatedReason: 这篇文章是面向患者的骨折术后科普指南，内容基础且无新的临床实践变化点。它不属于针对物理治疗师的专业新闻，因此对你的临床执业没有信息增量。
items.titleZh: 骨折術後照顧與復健指南：多久能恢復？怎麼好得快？
items.titleEn: Post-Fracture Care and Rehabilitation Guide: How Long to Recover? How to Heal Faster?
items.summaryZh: 本文提供骨折术后照护与复健的通用指南，涵盖骨折愈合阶段、影响因素及术后一般照护，面向患者。
items.curatedReasonEn: This article is a basic, patient-oriented guide on post-fracture care with no new clinical practice changes. It is not professional news for physical therapists and offers no incremental information for your clinical practice.

items.title: Systemic inflammation as a mediator of exercise benefits in chronic low back pain: Refining the mechanistic lens.
items.summary: This commentary explores systemic inflammation as a mediator of exercise benefits in chronic low back pain, refining the mechanistic lens through which these effects are understood.
items.curatedReason: 运动改善慢性下腰痛不仅是生物力学效应，这项述评提示我们可能与全身炎症反应有关。在与患者讨论运动益处时，你可以引入这一机制，提供更全面的解释，尤其对于合并炎症性疾病的患者。
items.titleZh: 全身炎症作为运动改善慢性下腰痛的介质：细化机制视角
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评探讨了全身炎症作为运动疗法改善慢性下腰痛的介质作用，旨在通过细化机制视角来深化对这些益处的理解。
items.curatedReasonEn: Exercise benefits in chronic low back pain might extend beyond biomechanical effects; this commentary suggests a link to systemic inflammation. When discussing the benefits of exercise with patients, you can incorporate this potential mechanism for a more holistic explanation, especially for those with co-existing inflammatory conditions.

items.title: "It's really, really just exercise I put my faith in now": Patients' perspectives on rotator cuff tendinopathy management: A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored the perspectives of 14 patients (aged 21-81, symptom duration 18-300m) with rotator cuff tendinopathy on management, identifying 33 subthemes across three themes, with patients prioritizing clarity around symptom onset and treatment outcomes and valuing clinicians who listened.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究涉及的14位肩袖肌腱病患者强烈渴望了解症状成因和治疗结果。你需要更清楚地解释病情和预后，并耐心倾听他们的顾虑，这能显著提升患者的满意度和依从性。
items.titleZh: “我现在真的只相信运动疗法了”：患者对肩袖肌腱病管理的看法：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究通过对14名国际肩袖肌腱病患者（21-81岁，症状持续18-300个月）的半结构化在线访谈，识别出3个主题下33个亚主题，发现患者优先关注症状起因和治疗结果的明确性，并珍视善于倾听的临床医生。
items.curatedReasonEn: The 14 patients with rotator cuff tendinopathy in this study strongly desire clarity on symptom onset and treatment outcomes. You must explain their condition and prognosis more clearly, and actively listen to their concerns, which will significantly improve patient satisfaction and adherence.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（14人），且通过在线访谈收集数据，可能影响结果的普适性和深度。
items.limitationEn: The study involved a small sample size (14 participants) and collected data via online interviews, which may limit the generalizability and depth of the findings.

items.title: Development and Content Validation of an Exercise-Based Framework for the Management of Lumbar Radiculopathy.
items.summary: Researchers developed and content-validated an exercise-based framework for lumbar radiculopathy management, integrating evidence-based exercise approaches and clinical expertise.
items.curatedReason: 这份研究构建并初步验证了一个基于运动的腰椎神经根病管理框架。这提示了未来标准化运动疗法方案的可能性，但在临床实践中广泛应用前还需要进一步的外部验证和对照试验。
items.titleZh: 腰椎神经根病运动管理框架的开发与内容验证
items.summaryZh: 研究人员开发并内容验证了一个结合循证运动方法和临床经验的腰椎神经根病运动管理框架。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study developed and content-validated an exercise-based framework for lumbar radiculopathy management, suggesting potential for standardized exercise protocols. However, further external validation and controlled trials are needed before widespread clinical adoption.
items.limitation: 研究仅进行了内容效度验证，并未评估该框架的临床疗效或与现有指南的对比效果。
items.limitationEn: The study only conducted content validation and did not evaluate the clinical efficacy of the framework or its comparative effectiveness against existing guidelines.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Upper-Limb Paresis Severity Is Associated With Practice Dosage During Task-Oriented Training in Subacute Stroke-An Exploratory Secondary Analysis.
items.summary: An exploratory secondary analysis of 33 subacute stroke patients found that upper-limb paresis severity is associated with the practice dosage achieved during task-oriented training.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性分析提示，卒中后上肢偏瘫的严重程度可能影响任务导向训练中的练习剂量。在制定训练计划时，要考虑患者的偏瘫程度，可能需要针对性地调整重复次数目标以达到最佳效果。
items.titleZh: 亚急性卒中患者上肢偏瘫严重程度与任务导向训练练习剂量的关联性：一项探索性二次分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对33名亚急性卒中患者进行的探索性二次分析发现，上肢偏瘫的严重程度与任务导向训练中达到的练习剂量存在关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory analysis suggests that upper-limb paresis severity post-stroke may influence practice dosage during task-oriented training. When planning training, consider the patient's paresis severity and potentially adjust repetition targets to achieve optimal outcomes.
items.limitation: 这是一项探索性二次分析，样本量较小（33名患者），结果的普适性和因果关系需谨慎解释，且研究未明确量化偏瘫严重程度对练习剂量的具体影响。
items.limitationEn: This was an exploratory secondary analysis with a small sample size (33 individuals), requiring cautious interpretation of generalizability and causality. The study did not quantify the specific impact of paresis severity on practice dosage.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Foot-Targeted Rehabilitation for Pronation-Related Anterior Knee Pain: A Two-Phase Case-Control Study and Single-Blind Randomized Controlled Trial of Manual Therapy Versus Neuromuscular Training Each With Augmented Low-Dye Taping.
items.summary: A two-phase study found that neuromuscular training with augmented low-dye taping (NMT + ALDT) was more effective in the short term for pronation-related anterior knee pain compared to routine physiotherapy care.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提示，对膝前痛合并足部旋前的患者，足部靶向治疗可能优于常规PT。特别是神经肌肉训练联用低染料贴扎（NMT + ALDT），短期效果显著。
items.titleZh: 足部靶向康复治疗旋前相关膝前痛：一项病例对照研究和单盲随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项两阶段研究发现，对于旋前相关膝前痛，神经肌肉训练联合加强型低染料贴扎（NMT + ALDT）在短期内效果优于常规物理治疗。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that foot-targeted therapy may be superior to routine PT for anterior knee pain with foot pronation. Specifically, neuromuscular training with augmented low-dye taping (NMT + ALDT) shows significant short-term effects.
items.limitation: 研究设计复杂，但可能存在分组不均衡和短期随访的局限性。
items.limitationEn: The study has a complex design but may be limited by imbalanced groups and short-term follow-up.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Respiratory Function in Participants with Spinal Cord Injury of a Rehabilitation Center using Neuromuscular Electrical Stimulation.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study observed respiratory function in 25 adults with chronic spinal cord injury (SCI) participating in a long-term neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) rehabilitation program.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究提供了神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）在长期脊髓损伤（SCI）患者呼吸功能方面的初步数据，但不能直接指导临床决策，需等待更高级别的证据。
items.titleZh: 康复中心长期使用神经肌肉电刺激的脊髓损伤患者呼吸功能
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面研究观察了25名长期脊髓损伤（SCI）成人患者的呼吸功能，这些患者参加了神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）康复项目。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study provides preliminary data on respiratory function in long-term spinal cord injury (SCI) patients using neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES), but cannot directly guide clinical decisions. Higher-level evidence is needed.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，且样本量较小。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, which cannot establish causality and has a small sample size.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Impacts of ankle sprain on functional performance in under-20 soccer players: a cross-sectional study.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 75 male under-20 soccer players found that those with a history of lateral ankle sprain had worse perceived ankle instability (CAIT), self-reported function (FAAM), ankle dorsiflexion (WBLT), and dynamic balance (YBT) compared to those without a history of sprain.
items.curatedReason: 有踝关节扭伤史的 U20 足球运动员在踝关节背屈活动度、本体感觉和动态平衡方面均表现出受损。这提示您在对年轻足球运动员进行伤后评估和重返赛场训练时，需全面筛查这些功能缺陷。
items.titleZh: 踝关节扭伤对 U20 足球运动员功能表现的影响：一项横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 75 名 U20 男性足球运动员进行的横断面研究发现，有踝关节扭伤史的运动员在踝关节不稳定性感知（CAIT）、自评功能（FAAM）、踝关节背屈活动度（WBLT）和动态平衡（YBT）方面均差于无扭伤史的运动员。
items.curatedReasonEn: U20 soccer players with a history of ankle sprain show impaired ankle dorsiflexion, proprioception, and dynamic balance. This suggests a need for comprehensive screening of these functional deficits when assessing and training young soccer players for return to sport after injury.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面观察性设计，无法确立踝关节扭伤与功能受损之间的因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional observational study cannot establish a causal relationship between ankle sprain and functional impairment.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Current Manual Therapy Practices in Pediatric Neurological Physiotherapy: A Cross-Sectional Survey.
items.summary: A cross-sectional survey of 61 Greek physiotherapists revealed that 55.7% used manual therapy as an adjunct intervention for children with neurological disorders, rating it most effective for joint mobility and range of motion. Formal manual therapy training correlated with higher perceived effectiveness for pain reduction (p=.013) and sensory processing (p=.004).
items.curatedReason: 这份希腊的调查报告展示了手动治疗在儿童神经物理治疗中的应用现状，特别指出其在改善关节活动度和本体感觉方面的价值。这为你在儿科神经康复中考虑引入或优化手动治疗提供了实证依据，但也要留意其辅助性定位。
items.titleZh: 希腊儿科神经物理治疗中手动治疗的当前实践：一项横断面调查
items.summaryZh: 一项针对61名希腊物理治疗师的横断面调查显示，55.7%的受访者将手动治疗作为儿童神经障碍的辅助干预手段，认为其对关节活动度改善效果最佳。正规手动治疗培训与疼痛减轻（p=.013）和感觉处理（p=.004）的感知有效性呈正相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This Greek survey reveals current manual therapy practices in pediatric neurological physiotherapy, highlighting its value in improving joint mobility and proprioception. It provides evidence for considering or optimizing manual therapy in your pediatric neurorehabilitation practice, while also noting its adjunctive role.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面调查，依赖于自我报告，可能存在回忆偏差和选择偏倚，且结果仅代表希腊的执业情况，外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional survey relies on self-reported data, potentially introducing recall and selection bias, and its findings are limited to Greek practice, thus having limited generalizability.

items.title: Effectiveness of In-Clinic Rehabilitation vs. Home-Based Telerehabilitation for Adults with MS in the Deep South: The TEAMS Cluster Randomized Trial.
items.summary: The TEAMS cluster-randomized trial of 759 adults with MS found no significant difference in effectiveness between a 12-week complementary and alternative medicine (CAM) program delivered in-clinic by a therapist (DirectCAM, n=382) versus self-initiated at home via telerehabilitation (TeleCAM, n=377).
items.curatedReason: TEAMS 试验显示，对于多发性硬化症患者，居家远程康复与诊所康复在效果上并无显著差异。这意味着你可以放心地为部分患者提供居家远程方案，扩展服务覆盖。
items.titleZh: 美国南部多发性硬化症成人患者诊所康复与居家远程康复有效性比较：TEAMS 集群随机试验
items.summaryZh: TEAMS 集群随机对照试验发现，对于759名多发性硬化症成人患者，由治疗师在诊所提供的12周辅助与替代医学（CAM）项目（DirectCAM, n=382）与居家自行启动的远程康复（TeleCAM, n=377）在有效性方面无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: The TEAMS trial indicates no significant difference in effectiveness between home-based telerehabilitation and in-clinic rehabilitation for MS patients. This allows you to confidently offer home-based telehealth options for some patients, expanding service reach.
items.limitation: 研究仅限于美国南部地区的MS患者，且只评估了12周的CAM项目。
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Experiences of telehealth e-mentoring within postgraduate musculoskeletal physical therapy education in Canada and the United Kingdom.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored the experiences of postgraduate physiotherapy mentees and mentors in telehealth e-mentoring in Canada, comparing findings with the UK to understand cross-cultural applicability in musculoskeletal physical therapy education.
items.curatedReason: 远程电子导师制在研究生骨骼肌肉物理治疗教育中展现出潜力，尤其在跨文化应用方面。你可以借鉴其在加拿大和英国的经验，优化自身教育或培训项目中的导师机制。
items.titleZh: 远程电子导师制在加拿大和英国研究生骨骼肌肉物理治疗教育中的经验
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了加拿大研究生物理治疗学员和导师在远程电子导师制中的经验，并与英国的情况进行了比较，以了解其在骨骼肌肉物理治疗教育中跨文化应用的潜力。
items.curatedReasonEn: Telehealth e-mentoring shows potential in postgraduate musculoskeletal physical therapy education, particularly for cross-cultural application. You can leverage the experiences from Canada and the UK to optimize mentoring mechanisms in your own educational or training programs.
items.limitation: 研究为定性设计，未提供量化效果数据，且探索的是主观体验。
items.limitationEn: The study employed a qualitative design, providing no quantitative effectiveness data, and focused on subjective experiences.

items.title: Sacroiliac Joint Dysfunction and Associated Disability in the Immediate Postpartum Period: A Cross-Sectional Analysis for Clinical Screening and Rehabilitation
items.summary: This descriptive cross-sectional study, involving 300 postpartum women aged 20-40 years in Sialkot, aimed to determine the prevalence of sacroiliac joint (SIJ) pain and assess the level of associated disability. SIJ pain is a common musculoskeletal condition in postpartum women.
items.curatedReason: 产后女性骶髂关节疼痛很常见，这项在巴基斯坦小样本（300人）的观察研究提示患病率可能不低，但研究设计本身无法提供干预的有效性证据。对你的临床实践来说，了解在特定人群中这一问题的普遍性，对你筛查和管理产后SIJ疼痛有一定提示意义。
items.titleZh: 产后即时期的骶髂关节功能障碍及相关残疾：一项用于临床筛查和康复的横断面分析
items.summaryZh: 这项描述性横断面研究在锡亚尔科特对 300 名 20-40 岁的产后女性进行了调查，旨在确定骶髂关节（SIJ）疼痛的患病率并评估其相关功能障碍程度。骶髂关节疼痛是产后女性常见的肌肉骨骼疾病。
items.curatedReasonEn: Sacroiliac joint pain is common in postpartum women. This small-sample (300 individuals) observational study from Pakistan suggests a potentially high prevalence, but its design cannot offer evidence for intervention effectiveness. For your clinical practice, understanding the prevalence in this specific population provides some direction for screening and managing postpartum SIJ pain.
items.limitation: 作为描述性横断面研究，本研究无法揭示病因或干预效果，且结果可能存在地域限制。
items.limitationEn: As a descriptive cross-sectional study, it cannot reveal causality or intervention effects, and its findings may have geographical limitations.

items.title: Relationship Between Physiological Mirror Activity and Corticomuscular Coherence During a Finger Dexterity Task Among Healthy Young and Older Adults
items.summary: This cross-sectional study investigated the relationship between physiological mirror activity (pMA) and corticomuscular coherence (CMC) during a left-hand finger dexterity task in 31 young and 24 older adults. It found that pMA, quantified by changes in right-hand EMG, was inversely associated with gamma-band CMC in both groups, with age-related differences in pMA.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性研究揭示了生理性镜像活动与皮层肌肉相干性在年轻人和老年人手指精细运动中的关系。这为你理解神经生理学机制及其在不同年龄组中的差异提供了基础，有助于你在神经康复中更精细地评估和干预。
items.titleZh: 健康年轻和老年人手指精细活动中生理性镜像活动与皮层肌肉相干性的关系
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面研究调查了 31 名年轻成人和 24 名老年成人进行左手手指精细活动时，生理性镜像活动（pMA）与皮层肌肉相干性（CMC）之间的关系。研究发现，由右手肌电图变化量化的 pMA 与伽马波段 CMC 呈负相关，且 pMA 存在年龄相关差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory study reveals the relationship between physiological mirror activity and corticomuscular coherence during fine finger dexterity in young and older adults. This provides a foundational understanding of neurophysiological mechanisms and their age-related differences, aiding in more refined assessment and intervention in neurological rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，且样本量相对较小。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, precluding the establishment of causality, and it has a relatively small sample size.

items.title: Association Between Danish Guideline Treatments for Breast Cancer and Physiotherapy-Relevant Late Effects: A Nationwide Cohort Study.
items.summary: A nationwide Danish cohort study investigated the association between guideline-based breast cancer treatments and the risk of self-reported shoulder impairment, lymphedema, and fatigue 3-7 years post-surgery.
items.curatedReason: 乳腺癌术后 3-7 年，肩部功能障碍、淋巴水肿和疲劳很常见。这项观察性研究提示，特定的指南治疗方案可能与这些晚期并发症的风险相关，你应该在临床中识别并管理高风险患者。
items.titleZh: 丹麦乳腺癌指南治疗与物理治疗相关晚期效应的关联：一项全国性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项丹麦全国性队列研究探讨了乳腺癌指南治疗与患者自报的肩部功能障碍、淋巴水肿和疲劳这三种物理治疗相关晚期效应在术后 3-7 年的关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: Shoulder impairment, lymphedema, and fatigue are common 3-7 years post-breast cancer surgery. This observational study suggests that specific guideline-based treatments might be associated with the risk of these late complications, prompting you to identify and manage high-risk patients in your practice.
items.limitation: 本研究基于患者自报的晚期并发症数据，可能存在回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: The study relies on patient-reported late effects, which may introduce recall bias.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Pregnancy-Related Musculoskeletal Pain: Current Management, Influence on Biopsychosocial Health, and Patient-Reported Satisfaction With Care.
items.summary: An international internet survey with 671 female respondents investigated the prevalence of musculoskeletal pain during pregnancy, its impact on biopsychosocial well-being, healthcare pain management, and its influence on satisfaction with prenatal care.
items.curatedReason: 孕期肌肉骨骼疼痛的普遍性不容忽视，这会显著影响患者的生物心理社会健康。这项调查提示，及时有效的疼痛管理，特别是物理治疗转诊，能提高患者对产前护理的满意度，指导你在临床沟通和转诊中优先考虑。
items.titleZh: 孕期肌肉骨骼疼痛：当前管理、对生物心理社会健康的影响及患者对护理满意度报告
items.summaryZh: 一项对全球 671 名女性的互联网调查研究了孕期肌肉骨骼疼痛的普遍性、对生物心理社会健康的影响、医疗管理（包括物理治疗转诊）以及对产前护理满意度的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: The prevalence of musculoskeletal pain during pregnancy is significant and profoundly impacts biopsychosocial well-being. This survey suggests that timely and effective pain management, especially physical therapy referrals, improves patient satisfaction with prenatal care; prioritize this in your clinical communication and referrals.
items.limitation: 本研究为互联网调查，可能存在选择偏倚，且无法建立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This internet-based survey may suffer from selection bias and cannot establish causality.

items.title: Telerehabilitation before and after lumbar spine surgery: A scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review mapped existing evidence on telerehabilitation interventions for patients undergoing lumbar spine surgery, focusing on intervention characteristics and identifying evidence gaps.
items.curatedReason: 腰椎手术后的远程康复干预已有一些证据，但仍有许多空白。这份范围综述总结了当前介入的特点，为你在该人群中初步探索远程康复提供方向，并提醒你现有证据尚未能支持大规模推广。
items.titleZh: 腰椎手术前后远程康复：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述系统梳理了腰椎手术患者远程康复干预的现有证据，重点关注干预特征并识别证据空白。
items.curatedReasonEn: While some evidence exists for telerehabilitation post-lumbar spine surgery, significant gaps remain. This scoping review outlines current intervention characteristics, guiding your initial exploration of telerehabilitation in this population, but be aware that the evidence does not yet support widespread implementation.
items.limitation: 范围综述侧重于映射证据而非评价质量，无法提供干预的确定性有效性结论。
items.limitationEn: Scoping reviews map existing evidence rather than assessing its quality, thus not providing definitive conclusions on intervention effectiveness.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: External validation of the minimal important change in the Berg Balance Scale scores of patients hospitalized for subacute stroke.
items.summary: A longitudinal study (n=286) investigated the external validation of several reported minimal important change (MIC) values in the Berg Balance Scale (BBS) scores for patients with subacute stroke in a rehabilitation unit.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提供了亚急性卒中患者 Berg 平衡量表 (BBS) 最小重要变化值 (MIC) 的外部验证数据，指导你如何解读 BBS 评分变化，并对步行能力不同的患者进行分层。
items.titleZh: 亚急性卒中住院患者 Berg 平衡量表评分最小重要变化值的外部验证
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 286 名亚急性卒中住院患者的纵向研究，外部验证了 Berg 平衡量表 (BBS) 评分的多个最小重要变化值 (MIC)，并按步行能力亚组进行分析。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study provides external validation data for the minimal important change (MIC) in Berg Balance Scale (BBS) scores for patients with subacute stroke, guiding you on interpreting BBS score changes and stratifying patients by walking ability.
items.limitation: 研究对象为特定康复单元的亚急性卒中患者，外推性可能受限。
items.limitationEn: The study was conducted on patients with subacute stroke in a specific rehabilitation unit, potentially limiting generalizability.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Accelerated Return to Competition Following a Full-Thickness Abdominal Wall Tear in an Elite Sprinter: A Data-informed Case Report.
items.summary: This data-informed case report describes the rehabilitation and accelerated return-to-competition process for a 22-year-old elite international sprinter following a full-thickness lateral abdominal wall tear.
items.curatedReason: 这份病例报告描述了一名精英短跑运动员腹壁全层撕裂的加速康复及重返赛场过程，为你处理类似罕见运动损伤提供了基于数据的个案指导，但请注意其个体性。
items.titleZh: 精英短跑运动员腹壁全层撕裂后加速重返赛场：一项基于数据的病例报告
items.summaryZh: 这份病例报告描述了一名 22 岁精英国际短跑运动员在遭遇腹壁外斜肌、内斜肌和腹横肌全层撕裂后，如何进行康复并加速重返赛场的过程。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case report describes the accelerated rehabilitation and return-to-competition process for an elite sprinter with a full-thickness abdominal wall tear, offering data-informed individual guidance for similar rare sports injuries, but be mindful of its uniqueness.
items.limitation: 作为单个病例报告，其结果的普遍适用性非常有限，不能作为一般性治疗指南。
items.limitationEn: As a single case report, its generalizability is highly limited and cannot serve as a general treatment guideline.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Effects of opioid-free intraoperative anesthesia versus opioid-based anesthesia on postoperative immune function in elderly patients undergoing total knee arthroplasty: a single-center, prospective, randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A single-center, prospective, randomized controlled trial investigates the effects of opioid-free intraoperative anesthesia versus opioid-based anesthesia on postoperative immune function in elderly patients undergoing total knee arthroplasty.
items.curatedReason: 对于全膝关节置换术的老年患者，无阿片类麻醉可能带来术后免疫功能改善的益处。在考虑术后康复方案时，应将这种麻醉选择对患者恢复的影响纳入考量。
items.titleZh: 老年全膝关节置换术中无阿片类麻醉对术后免疫功能影响的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项单中心、前瞻性随机对照试验旨在比较老年全膝关节置换术中，无阿片类麻醉与阿片类麻醉对患者术后免疫功能的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: Opioid-free anesthesia in elderly patients undergoing total knee arthroplasty may offer benefits in postoperative immune function. You should consider the impact of this anesthetic choice on patient recovery when planning postoperative rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 研究仅关注术后免疫功能，未报告直接的临床康复结局。
items.limitationEn: The study focused solely on postoperative immune function, without reporting direct clinical rehabilitation outcomes.

items.title: Associations between patient quality of life and caregiver burden among older adults receiving comprehensive geriatric assessment via telemedicine: a cross-sectional study from Seha Virtual Hospital, Saudi Arabia
items.summary: A cross-sectional study from Saudi Arabia explores associations between patient quality of life and caregiver burden among older adults receiving comprehensive geriatric assessment via telemedicine.
items.curatedReason: 远程医疗模式下，老年患者的生活质量与照护者负担之间存在显著关联。作为物理治疗师，你在远程康复中不仅要关注患者本身，也应主动识别和支持照护者，因为他们的负担会直接影响患者的康复依从性和效果。
items.titleZh: 沙特阿拉伯远程医疗综合老年评估中老年患者生活质量与照护者负担的关联
items.summaryZh: 一项来自沙特阿拉伯Seha虚拟医院的横断面研究，探讨了通过远程医疗接受综合老年评估的老年患者生活质量与照护者负担之间的关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: In telemedicine, there's a significant link between older patients' quality of life and caregiver burden. As a PT, in telerehabilitation, you must not only focus on the patient but also proactively identify and support caregivers, as their burden directly impacts patient adherence and rehabilitation outcomes.
items.limitation: 横断面研究无法建立因果关系，且研究人群和背景局限于沙特阿拉伯的虚拟医院，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional study cannot establish causality, and its population and context are limited to a virtual hospital in Saudi Arabia, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Surgical approaches for screw fixation of calcaneal fractures: a systematic review
items.summary: A systematic review summarizes evidence on different screw configurations for internal fixation of calcaneal fractures, identifying relevant studies from major databases up to December 2025.
items.curatedReason: 这份系统综述虽然聚焦跟骨骨折的手术固定方式，但仍有助你理解不同螺钉配置如何影响术后负重和康复进展的生物力学考量。在制定康复计划时，应向外科医生确认具体的固定情况。
items.titleZh: 跟骨骨折螺钉固定手术入路的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述总结了跟骨骨折内固定治疗中不同螺钉配置的证据，旨在为外科医生选择最佳方案提供参考。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review evaluates different screw fixation configurations for calcaneal fractures. While it focuses on surgical techniques, it can help you understand the biomechanical basis for postoperative weight-bearing restrictions and rehabilitation progression.
items.limitation: 该综述主要关注外科手术的比较，未直接涉及康复干预的结局。
items.limitationEn: The review primarily focuses on comparing surgical approaches and does not directly address rehabilitation intervention outcomes.

items.title: Situational characteristics of lower limb muscle cramps in male semi-elite football players: a video-based descriptive case series
items.summary: A video-based descriptive case series investigates the situational characteristics of lower limb muscle cramps in male semi-elite football players.
items.curatedReason: 半精英足球运动员的下肢肌肉痉挛，往往有其特定的发生情境。在评估和制定预防策略时，你需要更细致地询问痉挛的具体诱因和发生环境，因为这些细节可能比通用方案更有效。
items.titleZh: 半精英男足运动员下肢肌肉痉挛情境特征的视频描述性病例系列研究
items.summaryZh: 这项基于视频的描述性病例系列研究调查了半精英男性足球运动员下肢肌肉痉挛的情境特征。
items.curatedReasonEn: Lower limb muscle cramps in semi-elite football players often have specific situational characteristics. When assessing and developing prevention strategies, you need to inquire more precisely about the specific triggers and contexts of cramps, as these details may be more effective than general approaches.
items.limitation: 描述性研究，样本量小且局限于半精英男性足球运动员，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a descriptive study with a small sample size, limited to semi-elite male football players, thus limiting generalizability.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Differential neuromuscular adaptations following multi-joint vs single-joint resistance exercise training
items.summary: This study combines ultrasound, EMG, and dynamometry to establish differences in neuromechanical adaptations following multi-joint (squat) versus single-joint resistance training programs of equal training volume in 24 participants.
items.curatedReason: 多关节与单关节抗阻训练对神经肌肉适应性确实存在差异。在为患者设计抗阻训练时，不要仅仅关注训练量，更要根据运动特异性来选择多关节或单关节训练，以优化力量发展和功能恢复。
items.titleZh: 多关节与单关节抗阻训练对神经肌肉适应性的差异影响
items.summaryZh: 这项研究结合超声、肌电图和测力学测量，旨在评估多关节（深蹲）与单关节抗阻训练在神经肌肉适应性上的差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Multi-joint and single-joint resistance training indeed lead to different neuromuscular adaptations. When designing resistance training for patients, don't just focus on training volume; instead, choose multi-joint or single-joint exercises based on movement specificity to optimize strength development and functional recovery.
items.limitation: 研究细节不详，无法评估样本量和具体干预方案的严谨性。
items.limitationEn: Study details are insufficient to assess the rigor of sample size and specific intervention protocols.

items.title: Arthroscopic-assisted uni-portal spinal surgery versus unilateral biportal endoscopy for lumbar degenerative diseases: a systematic review and meta-analysis of clinical outcomes and complications
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis compares the clinical outcomes and complications of arthroscopic-assisted uni-portal spinal surgery versus unilateral biportal endoscopy for lumbar degenerative diseases.
items.curatedReason: 这份系统综述比较了两种微创脊柱内镜手术（关节镜辅助单通道与单侧双通道）在腰椎退行性疾病中的临床效果和并发症。尽管是外科内容，但这些手术选择直接影响患者术后康复路径和PT介入时机。
items.titleZh: 关节镜辅助单通道与单侧双通道脊柱内镜手术治疗腰椎退行性疾病的系统综述和Meta分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和Meta分析比较了关节镜辅助单通道脊柱手术与单侧双通道内镜手术治疗腰椎退行性疾病的临床结局和并发症。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review compares two minimally invasive endoscopic spinal surgeries (arthroscopic-assisted uni-portal vs. unilateral biportal) for lumbar degenerative diseases in terms of clinical outcomes and complications. Although surgical, these choices directly impact patients' postoperative rehabilitation pathways and PT intervention timing.
items.limitation: 该综述聚焦外科手术方法的比较，未直接分析不同术式对康复结局的具体影响。
items.limitationEn: The review focuses on comparing surgical methods and does not directly analyze the specific impact of different techniques on rehabilitation outcomes.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - Ahpra appoints new head of its Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Strategy Unit
items.summary: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (Ahpra) has announced the appointment of a new head for its Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Strategy Unit.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构（Ahpra）任命了新的原住民和托雷斯海峡岛民健康战略部门负责人。虽然是行政任命，但此类举措可能预示着未来在文化安全医疗和多元化执业方面会有更多政策倾斜，对你在澳大利亚的执业环境有潜在影响。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构任命原住民和托雷斯海峡岛民健康战略部门新负责人
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构（Ahpra）宣布任命原住民和托雷斯海峡岛民健康战略部门的新负责人。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (Ahpra) has appointed a new head for its Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Strategy Unit. While an administrative appointment, such moves may signal future policy emphasis on culturally safe healthcare and diverse practice, potentially impacting your practice environment in Australia.

items.title: Moving Forward Together. Part 6: Transforming Musculoskeletal Health Physical Therapy for Indigenous Peoples-A Call to Action.
items.summary: The 'Moving Forward Together' series calls on musculoskeletal physical therapists, organizations, and systems to engage in a multisector effort to improve musculoskeletal care and outcomes for Indigenous Peoples in clinical practice, research, and education.
items.curatedReason: 本系列文章直接呼吁你所在的肌肉骨骼物理治疗机构和系统，必须正视并改善原住民的肌肉骨骼健康不平等问题。作为临床医生，你的角色不仅仅是治疗，更是要在实践、研究和教育中积极成为原住民社区的盟友和倡导者。
items.titleZh: 携手前行。第六部分：为原住民的肌肉骨骼健康物理治疗转型——行动号召。
items.summaryZh: “携手前行”系列呼吁肌肉骨骼物理治疗师、组织和系统在临床实践、研究和教育中共同努力，改善原住民的肌肉骨骼护理和结局。
items.curatedReasonEn: This series is a direct call for your musculoskeletal PT practice and system to confront and improve health inequities for Indigenous Peoples. Beyond direct treatment, you are urged to actively become an ally and advocate within Indigenous communities across your clinical practice, research, and educational roles.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Additive Effects of Repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation and Transcranial Direct Current Stimulation on Robotic Therapy for Upper Extremity Recovery After Chronic Ischemic Stroke: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Sham-Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled trial (N=36) found that adding repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) or transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) to robotic therapy did not provide additional benefits for upper extremity motor and functional recovery in patients with chronic ischemic stroke.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性缺血性卒中上肢功能障碍患者，这项 N=36 的 RCT 明确指出，在机器人治疗基础上增加 rTMS 或 tDCS 并不能带来额外的运动和功能恢复益处。这提示我们，不应盲目叠加这些治疗方式，审慎评估其必要性。
items.titleZh: 重复经颅磁刺激和经颅直流电刺激联合机器人疗法对慢性缺血性卒中上肢恢复的累加效应：一项随机、双盲、假对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机、双盲、假对照试验（N=36）发现，对慢性缺血性卒中上肢功能障碍患者，在机器人疗法基础上额外增加重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）或经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）并未带来额外的运动和功能恢复益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: This N=36 RCT strongly indicates that adding rTMS or tDCS to robotic therapy offers no additional benefits for upper extremity motor and functional recovery in patients with chronic ischemic stroke. You should reconsider the clinical utility of combining these modalities and avoid unnecessary treatment layering.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小（N=36），可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study's relatively small sample size (N=36) may limit the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Exercise prescription: Physiotherapy's most important and least standardized skill.
items.summary: This commentary highlights the pervasive inconsistency and lack of standardization in exercise prescription within musculoskeletal physiotherapy, emphasizing the need for a shared language and systematic process.
items.curatedReason: 在你的临床实践中，运动处方的标准化不足很常见。这篇文章点出了痛点，强调 PT 行业需要建立更统一的语言和流程来指导运动处方的制定和沟通，这应该推动你反思自己的处方习惯。
items.titleZh: 运动处方：物理治疗中最重要但标准化程度最低的技能
items.summaryZh: 这篇评论指出，肌肉骨骼物理治疗中运动处方普遍存在不一致和标准化不足的问题，强调需要建立统一的语言和系统流程。
items.curatedReasonEn: In your clinical practice, the lack of standardization in exercise prescription is common. This article highlights critical pain points, emphasizing the need for a more unified language and process in the PT profession to guide the development and communication of exercise prescriptions. This should prompt you to reflect on your own prescribing habits.

items.title: From Injury to Inclusion: Evidence From the International Spinal Cord Injury Survey (InSCI).
items.summary: An evidence map of the International Spinal Cord Injury Community Survey (InSCI) identified 117 peer-reviewed publications by April 2026, with healthcare needs and epidemiology being the largest categories, indicating significant research contributions and remaining knowledge gaps.
items.curatedReason: InSCI 问卷的证据图谱让你对全球脊髓损伤（SCI）研究的广度、焦点和知识缺口有清晰认识。可利用它快速定位你感兴趣的 SCI 亚专业方向，避免重复工作。
items.titleZh: 从损伤到融合：国际脊髓损伤调查（InSCI）的证据
items.summaryZh: 国际脊髓损伤社区调查（InSCI）的证据图谱显示，截至 2026 年 4 月，已产生 117 篇同行评议论文，其中医疗需求和流行病学是最大的类别，表明其显著的研究贡献和尚存的知识缺口。
items.curatedReasonEn: This InSCI evidence map, covering 117 peer-reviewed publications by April 2026, highlights that research is heavily concentrated on healthcare needs and epidemiology. If you're involved in spinal cord injury (SCI) research, use this map to quickly grasp current foci and identify under-researched areas, streamlining your efforts.
items.limitation: 证据图谱本身是对现有文献的汇总分析，不提供新的临床干预效果证据。
items.limitationEn: The evidence map itself is a summary analysis of existing literature and does not provide new evidence on the effects of clinical interventions.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Integrated rehabilitation incorporating aquatic therapy following posterior cruciate ligament reconstruction: a case report.
items.summary: A case report of a 51-year-old woman showed that integrated rehabilitation incorporating aquatic therapy following PCL reconstruction helped facilitate early functional recovery and reduced joint loading.
items.curatedReason: PCL 重建术后水疗的证据仍然稀缺。本病例报告提示水疗在早期功能恢复中可能发挥作用，但别把它当成常规方案。
items.titleZh: 整合水疗的后交叉韧带重建术后康复：一例病例报告
items.summaryZh: 一例 51 岁女性的病例报告显示，后交叉韧带（PCL）重建术后整合水疗的康复方案有助于促进早期功能恢复并减轻关节负荷。
items.curatedReasonEn: Evidence for aquatic therapy after PCL reconstruction remains scarce. This case report suggests aquatic therapy may facilitate early functional recovery, but don't integrate it into routine protocols yet.
items.limitation: 本研究为单病例报告，证据等级低，结果外推性差。
items.limitationEn: This is a single case report with a low level of evidence and limited generalizability.

items.title: Repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation for Dizziness, Balance, and Postural Stability in Adult Patients With Chronic Peripheral Vestibular Dizziness.
items.summary: A double-blind RCT with 56 adults with chronic vestibular dizziness found that repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) combined with vestibular rehabilitation (VR) significantly improved dizziness, balance, and postural stability over 8 weeks compared to sham stimulation + VR.
items.curatedReason: 这项高质量 RCT 表明，经颅磁刺激（rTMS）联合前庭康复能显著改善慢性前庭性眩晕患者的眩晕症状、平衡和姿势稳定性，为这类难治性患者提供了新的干预策略。
items.titleZh: 重复经颅磁刺激对慢性周围性前庭性眩晕成年患者眩晕、平衡和姿势稳定性的影响。
items.summaryZh: 一项对56名慢性前庭性眩晕成年患者的双盲随机对照试验显示，重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）联合前庭康复（VR）治疗8周后，患者的眩晕、平衡和姿势稳定性均得到显著改善，优于安慰剂刺激联合VR组。
items.curatedReasonEn: This high-quality RCT indicates that repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) combined with vestibular rehabilitation significantly improves dizziness, balance, and postural stability in patients with chronic peripheral vestibular dizziness, offering a new intervention strategy for these challenging cases.
items.limitation: 研究评估了为期 8 周的治疗效果，但需要更长期的随访来确定维持效果。
items.limitationEn: The study evaluated effects over an 8-week treatment period, but longer-term follow-up is needed to determine sustained benefits.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Effects of a Virtual Reality-Based Balance Training Program on Clinical Outcomes and Cortical Oscillatory Activity: A Combined Behavioral and EEG Study.
items.summary: A prospective single-group repeated-measures study (n=28) found that 12 VR balance training sessions over 4 weeks improved clinical mobility outcomes and altered cortical oscillatory activity in subacute stroke survivors.
items.curatedReason: 虚拟现实平衡训练对亚急性卒中患者的平衡和皮层活动有积极影响。这提示 VR 技术可作为传统康复的有效补充，但还需要更强力的随机对照证据来明确其临床定位。
items.titleZh: 虚拟现实平衡训练对临床结果和皮层振荡活动的影响：一项行为与脑电图结合研究
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性单组重复测量研究（n=28）显示，亚急性卒中幸存者完成 4 周共 12 次虚拟现实平衡训练后，临床移动性结局得到改善，皮层振荡活动也发生变化。
items.curatedReasonEn: VR-based balance training showed positive effects on balance and cortical activity in subacute stroke survivors. This suggests VR technology can supplement traditional rehab, but stronger RCT evidence is needed to clarify its clinical role.
items.limitation: 这是一项单组重复测量研究，缺乏对照组，无法排除安慰剂效应或自然恢复的影响。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-group repeated-measures study lacking a control group, preventing the exclusion of placebo effects or natural recovery.

items.title: Effects of sportsmetrics training on biomechanical and functional performance outcomes related to ACL injury risk: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis confirmed the positive effects of SportsMetrics training on ACL injury-related biomechanical deficits and functional performance outcomes in athletes.
items.curatedReason: 如果你在设计 ACL 损伤预防或康复项目，可以有信心地将 SportsMetrics 训练纳入考量。这项高质量的系统综述和荟萃分析确证了它能有效改善与 ACL 损伤风险相关的生物力学和功能性表现。
items.titleZh: SportsMetrics 训练对 ACL 损伤风险相关生物力学和功能表现结局的影响：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析证实了 SportsMetrics 训练对运动员 ACL 损伤相关生物力学缺陷和功能表现结局的积极影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: You can confidently incorporate SportsMetrics training into your ACL injury prevention or rehabilitation programs. This high-quality systematic review and meta-analysis confirms its effectiveness in improving ACL injury-related biomechanical deficits and functional performance outcomes.
items.limitation: 虽然是系统综述，但原始研究间的异质性或研究质量差异可能影响了综合结果的强度。
items.limitationEn: Although a systematic review, heterogeneity or quality differences among original studies may affect the strength of the pooled results.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Short-term inspiratory muscle training, aerobic exercise, and detraining in women with COPD: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial in women with COPD found that short-term inspiratory muscle training (IMT), aerobic exercise (AE), and combined IMT+AE all significantly improved inspiratory muscle strength, exercise capacity, and quality of life, with effects diminishing after a detraining period.
items.curatedReason: 这项随机对照试验表明，短期吸气肌训练（IMT）和有氧运动（AE）都能改善女性 COPD 患者的心肺功能和生活质量，且停训后效果会减弱。这支持你为 COPD 患者提供有氧运动和 IMT，并强调了持续训练的重要性。
items.titleZh: COPD 女性短期吸气肌训练、有氧运动和停训效应：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 COPD 女性的随机对照试验发现，短期吸气肌训练（IMT）、有氧运动（AE）以及联合训练均能显著改善吸气肌力量、运动能力和生活质量，但停训后效果有所减弱。
items.curatedReasonEn: This randomized controlled trial indicates that short-term inspiratory muscle training (IMT) and aerobic exercise (AE) both improve cardiopulmonary function and quality of life in women with COPD, with effects diminishing after detraining. This supports providing aerobic exercise and IMT for COPD patients and highlights the importance of continuous training.
items.limitation: 研究对象仅为女性COPD患者，结果外推到男性或其他COPD亚型时需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study included only female COPD patients, so caution is needed when generalizing results to men or other COPD subtypes.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Manifestations of Oral Muscle Mass, Tongue Strength, and Endurance in Patients with Stroke Across Varying Degrees of Swallowing Function: A Pilot Study.
items.summary: A pilot cross-sectional study of 41 stroke patients found varying oral muscle mass, elasticity, and tongue performance across different swallowing function levels (FOIS 1-3, 4-6, 7), assessed using ultrasonography and sonoelastography.
items.curatedReason: 这项纳入 41 名卒中患者的探索性研究提示，不同吞咽功能水平（FOIS 1-3, 4-6, 7）与口腔肌肉质量、弹性及舌功能表现存在关联。评估吞咽障碍时，应考虑将超声及超声弹性成像作为补充工具，以更精细地识别潜在的病理生理机制。
items.titleZh: 卒中患者不同吞咽功能水平下口腔肌肉质量、舌力量和耐力的表现：一项初步研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 41 名卒中患者进行的初步横断面研究发现，根据功能性口腔摄入量表（FOIS）分级，口腔肌肉质量、弹性以及舌功能表现（通过超声和声波弹性成像评估）在不同吞咽功能水平的患者之间存在差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot study with 41 stroke patients suggests a link between varying swallowing function levels (FOIS 1-3, 4-6, 7) and oral muscle mass, elasticity, and tongue performance. When assessing dysphagia, consider ultrasonography and sonoelastography as supplementary tools for a more refined identification of underlying pathophysiological mechanisms.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面小样本研究（n=41），难以建立因果关系，结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a small cross-sectional pilot study (n=41), which limits the ability to establish causality and generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Altered inter-joint coordination strategies of the lower extremity and pelvis in elite rowers with chronic low back pain
items.summary: Elite rowers with chronic low back pain exhibit altered inter-joint coordination strategies of the lower extremity and pelvis, as identified in this study.
items.curatedReason: 有慢性腰痛的精英赛艇运动员可能存在下肢和骨盆的关节间协调策略改变。评估这类患者时，除了传统检查，应关注其运动模式和协调性，这可能对你的生物力学分析和干预方案设计有提示作用。
items.titleZh: 慢性腰痛精英赛艇运动员下肢和骨盆关节间协调策略的改变
items.summaryZh: 这项研究发现，患有慢性腰痛的精英赛艇运动员在下肢和骨盆的关节间协调策略上存在改变。
items.curatedReasonEn: Elite rowers with chronic low back pain may exhibit altered inter-joint coordination strategies of the lower extremity and pelvis. When assessing these patients, beyond traditional examinations, pay attention to their movement patterns and coordination, as this may inform your biomechanical analysis and intervention design.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Exercise training during hospitalization in community-acquired pneumonia: effects on functional ability, body composition, and physical activity level
items.summary: Exercise programs applied during acute hospitalization for community-acquired pneumonia may improve functional ability, body composition, and physical activity levels.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提示，对于社区获得性肺炎住院患者，住院期间的运动训练可能改善其功能能力、身体成分和体力活动水平。这能支持你在急性期积极介入，降低患者因卧床导致的衰退风险。
items.titleZh: 社区获得性肺炎住院期间运动训练：对功能能力、身体成分和体力活动水平的影响
items.summaryZh: 研究显示，在社区获得性肺炎患者急性住院期间实施的运动计划，可能改善其功能能力、身体成分和体力活动水平。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that exercise training during hospitalization for community-acquired pneumonia may improve functional ability, body composition, and physical activity levels. This supports active intervention during the acute phase to reduce the risk of decline due to bed rest.
items.limitation: 摘要未提供研究设计细节或样本量，限制了对其证据强度的全面评估。
items.limitationEn: The abstract does not provide details on study design or sample size, limiting a full assessment of its evidence strength.

items.title: Understanding Anterior Cruciate Ligament Adaptation: Structural, Mechanical, and Healing Considerations
items.summary: This narrative review synthesizes animal and human evidence on ACL mechanobiology, emphasizing its adaptive nature to mechanical stimuli and its role beyond a passive stabilizer.
items.curatedReason: ACL 不仅仅是被动稳定结构，它能动态响应机械刺激，具备适应性和愈合能力。这份综述提醒我们，在 ACL 损伤的评估和康复中，应充分考虑其生物力学特性和愈合潜力，而不是仅将其视为一个简单的机械结构。
items.titleZh: 理解前交叉韧带适应：结构、力学和愈合考量
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述综合了动物和人类关于 ACL 机械生物学的证据，强调其对机械刺激的适应性以及作为被动稳定器之外的作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: The ACL is not merely a passive stabilizer; it dynamically responds to mechanical stimuli, demonstrating adaptive and healing capabilities. This review reminds us to fully consider its biomechanical properties and healing potential in ACL injury assessment and rehabilitation, rather than viewing it as a simple mechanical structure.
items.limitation: 作为一篇叙述性综述，其证据等级低于系统综述或RCT，可能存在作者选择偏倚。
items.limitationEn: As a narrative review, its evidence level is lower than that of systematic reviews or RCTs, and author selection bias may be present.

items.title: Influence of knee hyperextension persisting into preswing on swing-phase kinematics through forward propulsion in poststroke hemiparetic gait.
items.summary: A study with 30 chronic poststroke hemiparetic patients found that knee hyperextension persisting into preswing was associated with reduced peak forward propulsive force and altered swing-phase kinematics, including functional limb shortening and peak knee-flexion angle.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示卒中偏瘫步态中摆前膝关节过伸与推进力减弱、摆动期运动学改变相关。这提示临床在评估和干预卒中患者步态时，需关注摆前膝过伸模式，可能与后续推进效率和肢体功能长度改变有关。
items.titleZh: 卒中偏瘫步态中摆前膝关节过伸对摆动期运动学和前向推进力的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项对 30 名慢性卒中偏瘫患者的研究发现，膝关节过伸持续至摆前阶段与峰值前向推进力减弱以及摆动期运动学改变（包括功能性肢体缩短和膝关节屈曲峰值角度）相关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that preswing knee hyperextension in poststroke hemiparetic gait is associated with reduced forward propulsion and altered swing-phase kinematics. Clinicians should consider preswing knee hyperextension when assessing and intervening in stroke gait, as it may impact propulsion efficiency and functional limb shortening.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本观察性研究，结论的因果关系和普适性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a small-sample observational study, limiting the generalizability and causal inference of its findings.

items.title: Cardiovascular and autonomic responses to transcutaneous spinal cord stimulation combined with activity-based therapy after chronic spinal cord injury: An exploratory study from the MACHINE trial
items.summary: An exploratory case series from a randomized trial involving 8 adults with chronic motor-complete spinal cord injury found that 12 weeks of body weight-supported treadmill training combined with transcutaneous spinal cord stimulation led to changes in cardiovascular and autonomic responses, including improvements in blood pressure regulation.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性脊髓损伤患者，经皮脊髓电刺激结合活动性疗法（如 BWSTT）可能影响心血管和自主神经反应。在临床实践中，您应关注这种组合干预在改善自主神经功能障碍方面的潜力，但需注意其仍处于探索阶段，数据来自小样本。
items.titleZh: 慢性脊髓损伤后经皮脊髓电刺激结合活动性疗法的心血管与自主神经反应：MACHINE 试验的探索性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 8 名慢性运动完全性脊髓损伤成人进行的探索性案例研究（来自 MACHINE 随机试验）发现，为期 12 周的体重支持跑台训练结合经皮脊髓电刺激，能改变心血管和自主神经反应，包括改善血压调节。
items.curatedReasonEn: For individuals with chronic spinal cord injury, transcutaneous spinal cord stimulation combined with activity-based therapy (like BWSTT) may influence cardiovascular and autonomic responses. In practice, you should be aware of this combination's potential to improve autonomic dysfunction, but note that it is still in an exploratory phase with small sample data.
items.limitation: 本研究是来自更大试验的探索性案例系列，样本量小（n=8），且未报告主要结局的效应量。
items.limitationEn: This study is an exploratory case series from a larger trial with a small sample size (n=8) and did not report effect sizes for primary outcomes.

items.title: When algorithms don't care: physiotherapy and the post-professional turn.
items.summary: This paper analyzes how physiotherapy, traditionally resistant to restructuring forces, is entering a post-professional era marked by practitioner marginalization due to commodification, challenges to expertise, and digital disruption.
items.curatedReason: PT 行业正在进入一个“后专业化”时代，这可能导致专业人员被边缘化。你需要警惕商品化、专业知识受到挑战以及数字化颠覆带来的潜在冲击，并开始思考如何适应这些变化。
items.titleZh: 当算法不关心：物理治疗与后专业化转向
items.summaryZh: 本文分析了传统上抵制重组力量的物理治疗如何进入一个“后专业化”时代，其特点是由于商品化、专业知识面临挑战以及数字颠覆，从业者在护理协调和提供中的边缘化。
items.curatedReasonEn: The PT profession is entering a “post-professional” era, potentially leading to practitioner marginalization. You need to be aware of the impending impacts of commodification, challenges to expertise, and digital disruption, and begin strategizing how to adapt.

items.title: Growing Our Impact and Advancing Pediatric Physical Therapy.
items.summary: This article discusses strategies for expanding the impact and advancing the field of pediatric physical therapy.
items.curatedReason: 这是一篇社论，着眼于儿科物理治疗的未来发展和影响力。虽然是行业内部观点，但提醒我们关注儿科专业领域的整体战略方向。
items.titleZh: 壮大影响力，推进儿科物理治疗。
items.summaryZh: 本文探讨了扩大儿科物理治疗影响力并推进该领域发展的策略。
items.curatedReasonEn: This editorial focuses on the future development and impact of pediatric physical therapy. While it offers an internal perspective, it serves as a reminder to consider the overall strategic direction within the pediatric specialty.
