items.journal: Pediatric physical therapy : the official publication of the Section on Pediatrics of the American Physical Therapy Association

items.title: Quality indicators for Spanish hospital-based physical therapy units: a feasibility and inter-rater reliability study.
items.summary: A Spanish multicenter observational study assessed the feasibility and inter-rater reliability of 22 quality indicators for hospital-based physical therapy units, identifying 13 indicators that were both feasible and showed high concordance across evaluators.
items.curatedReason: 这份西班牙多中心研究，在评估医院物理治疗科室质量指标的工具化方面有不错的信噪比。它确认了 13 个具有可行性和跨评估者一致性的指标，为日后制定 PT 科室质量管理标准提供了实证基础。
items.titleZh: 西班牙医院物理治疗科室质量指标：可行性与评估者间信度研究
items.summaryZh: 一项西班牙多中心观察研究评估了医院物理治疗科室 22 项质量指标的可行性与评估者间信度，其中 13 项指标被证实可行且评估者间一致性高。
items.curatedReasonEn: This multicenter study from Spain offers good signal-to-noise ratio in instrumenting quality indicators for hospital-based physical therapy units. It validates 13 indicators with demonstrated feasibility and inter-rater reliability, providing an empirical basis for future PT department quality management standards.
items.limitation: 研究仅在西班牙三家医院进行，其结果在其他医疗系统中的普适性有待验证。
items.limitationEn: The study was conducted in only three hospitals in Spain, and the generalizability of its findings to other healthcare systems requires further validation.

items.title: Bidirectional association between injuries and mental health symptoms among elite athletes: a systematic review
items.summary: A systematic review of 25 studies found a bidirectional association between musculoskeletal injuries and mental health symptoms among elite athletes, indicating that mental health symptoms can precede injury, and injury can lead to subsequent mental health symptoms.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述明确了精英运动员伤病与心理健康症状之间的双向关联。你需要认识到，心理健康问题可能导致受伤，而受伤反过来也会影响心理健康，因此在康复和预防中，务必同时评估和管理这两个方面。
items.titleZh: 精英运动员伤病与心理健康症状之间的双向关联：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 25 项研究的系统综述发现，精英运动员的肌肉骨骼损伤与心理健康症状之间存在双向关联，表明心理健康症状可能先于受伤，而受伤也可能导致随后的心理健康症状。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review clarifies the bidirectional association between injuries and mental health symptoms in elite athletes. You need to recognize that mental health issues can lead to injuries, and injuries, in turn, can affect mental health, making it crucial to assess and manage both aspects concurrently in rehabilitation and prevention.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的方法学异质性较高，且多数研究为观察性，无法完全确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: The included studies had high methodological heterogeneity, and most were observational, thus not fully establishing causality.

items.title: Biopsychosocial predictors of functional recovery in chronic low back pain following physiotherapy: A survival analysis study.
items.summary: A prospective observational cohort study of 250 adults with chronic non-specific low back pain found that baseline biopsychosocial factors, particularly Oswestry Disability Index (ODI) and pain catastrophizing, predicted functional recovery time following individualized physiotherapy.
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性队列研究提示，慢性腰痛患者接受物理治疗后，功能恢复时间受到基线生物心理社会因素的显著影响，其中ODI和疼痛灾难化是主要预测因子。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗后慢性腰痛功能恢复的生物心理社会预测因子：一项生存分析研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 250 名慢性非特异性腰痛成人进行的前瞻性观察队列研究发现，基线生物心理社会因素，特别是 Oswestry 残障指数 (ODI) 和疼痛灾难化，能够预测个体化物理治疗后的功能恢复时间。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective cohort study suggests that functional recovery time in chronic low back pain patients undergoing physiotherapy is significantly influenced by baseline biopsychosocial factors, with ODI and pain catastrophizing identified as key predictors.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心观察性研究，缺乏对照组且随访时间相对较短，可能存在混杂因素影响结果。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center observational study without a control group and a relatively short follow-up, potentially leading to confounding factors influencing the results.

items.title: Applying the International Classification of Functioning, Disability and Health to Classify Upper Limb Outcome Measures in Stroke Rehabilitation: A Construct-Driven Perspective.
items.summary: This perspective emphasizes using the International Classification of Functioning, Disability and Health (ICF) to classify upper limb outcome measures in stroke rehabilitation, advocating for a construct-driven approach to clarify whether measures assess neuromuscular impairments or activity limitations.
items.curatedReason: 这项分析强调，在卒中康复中，上肢功能评估应更清晰地结合 ICF 框架，区分评估的是损伤还是活动受限，避免测量工具解读混淆。
items.titleZh: 运用国际功能、残疾和健康分类法对卒中康复上肢结局测量进行分类：一项以结构为导向的视角
items.summaryZh: 本视角强调在卒中康复中运用国际功能、残疾和健康分类法（ICF）对上肢结局测量进行分类，倡导以结构为导向的方法，以明确测量工具评估的是神经肌肉损伤还是活动受限。
items.curatedReasonEn: This analysis emphasizes that upper limb functional assessment in stroke rehabilitation should more clearly integrate the ICF framework to distinguish between impairment and activity limitation, preventing measurement tool misinterpretation.

items.title: The effect of online physical activity monitoring on physical activity level, psychological health, fatigue, and quality of life in patients with multiple sclerosis: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial with 42 individuals with multiple sclerosis (MS) found that continuous online monitoring of walking-based physical activity via a messaging application significantly improved physical activity levels, psychological health, and quality of life.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 提示，通过消息应用程序进行在线身体活动监测，能有效提升多发性硬化症（MS）患者的身体活动水平、心理健康和生活质量，你可以考虑将这类数字工具整合到 MS 患者的康复管理中。
items.titleZh: 在线身体活动监测对多发性硬化症患者身体活动水平、心理健康、疲劳和生活质量的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 42 名多发性硬化症（MS）患者的随机对照试验发现，通过消息应用程序持续监测步行活动显著改善了患者的身体活动水平、心理健康和生活质量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that online physical activity monitoring via messaging apps can effectively improve physical activity levels, psychological health, and quality of life in MS patients. You may consider integrating such digital tools into MS rehabilitation management.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（42 人），且干预时间相对较短，长期效果和推广性仍需进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This study had a small sample size (42 participants) and a relatively short intervention period, so long-term effects and generalizability require further validation.

items.title: Depressive symptoms in high-performance athletes and non-athletes: a comparative meta-analysis update
items.summary: An updated comparative meta-analysis of 10 studies found no significant difference in the prevalence of mild or more severe depressive symptoms between high-performance athletes and non-athletes.
items.curatedReason: 这项更新的荟萃分析发现，与非运动员相比，高水平运动员出现轻度或更严重抑郁症状的风险并无显著差异。这挑战了“运动员心理更健康”的普遍观念，提示你在实践中应平等关注运动员的心理健康。
items.titleZh: 高水平运动员与非运动员抑郁症状的比较荟萃分析更新
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖 10 项研究的比较荟萃分析更新发现，高水平运动员与非运动员之间，轻度或更严重抑郁症状的患病率没有显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This updated meta-analysis finds no significant difference in the risk of mild or severe depressive symptoms between high-performance athletes and non-athletes. This challenges the common perception of athletes being mentally healthier, prompting you to equally prioritize athletes' mental health in practice.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的数量有限（10 项），且存在方法学异质性，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The limited number of included studies (10) and methodological heterogeneity may affect the generalizability of the results.
